rationale: The supplied bounded evidence supports verified_change as the non-authorizing eventual delivery-path candidate: one canonical owner, bounded source and derived paths, clean baseline, deterministic propagation and validation, and no prohibited impacts. compact_delivery is not eligible because the fixture does not show a completed Brownfield analysis or stored quick_task context.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
canonical_owner_count=1 and source_path_count=1 establish bounded canonical ownership.
derived_path_count=2 with deterministic_propagation=true supports controlled derived-path propagation.
baseline_clean=true and deterministic_validation=true support compact deterministic verification.
All supplied prohibited-impact categories are false.
Any impact broader than the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
No completed Brownfield analysis is visible.
No stored quick_task context is visible; therefore compact_delivery requirements are unmet.
This is a benchmark candidate only and does not constitute a Mode/Slice Decision or approval.
